label: Beginner · Lesson 27
title: Do you…? Does she…?
intro: Questions with Do and Does, and short answers. Today’s words and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Do va Does bilan so’roq gaplar, qisqa javoblar. Bugungi so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 27 · Do you…? Does she…? Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Do or Does?
items: Do you know Bobur? Yes, I {do|know}.
Does your mother cook? No, she {don’t|doesn’t}.

parts.title: Short answers
items: Do you drink tea? Yes, I ___.
Do they live here? Yes, they ___.
Does she use a computer? Yes, she ___.
Do you speak Russian? No, I ___.
Does your cat eat fish? No, it ___.

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {is|are} a cat under the table.

items.prompt: Write 4 questions for a friend: 2 with Do you…? and 2 with Does your…?
items.hint: Example: Do you like plov? Does your mother drive?
